newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission to adopt social dialogue communication.
newsitem.headline: Commission to adopt social dialogue communication.

text.p: The European Commission will on Wednesday adopt a communication opening consultations with the three social partners on how to improve the social dialogue, a Commission spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

The consultations -- which the Commission hopes to complete by the end of the year after which it will draw up a policy document -- aims to analyse the good and bad points of dialogue between the EU's employers, unions and public sector union.
Under the social dialogue the EU consults management and labour groups or has them negotiate their own labour accords under the social protocol of the Maastricht Treaty.

The spokeswoman said the Commission will try not to step into the row between the existing social partners and groups representing small and medium sized enterprises, who say they should be involved in the process.
The Commission says that only the social partners can resolve that problem.
